x: Jack Holden was tucked inside some 15 yards further behind, with Alec Burns not far away. Of ours, Arthur Penny came next, with Tom Evenson and Bert Footer all together at the head of the main bunch, and ours close enough to be "alright."
Alec Burns and Jack Holden proved great favourites with the boys.

Gregory could not be there as he would have made the race more interesting for the first three places. A. Burns, one of our new men from Eastleigh, was most unfortunate to be disqualified in the first 50 yards.
The winner Noji (Poland) set up a new British record of 29 mins. 43.4 secs., whilst runner-up A. Burns, Elswick Harriers, set new figures for the native British record.
